title: Canonical derived direct image comparison for forgotten module coefficients
statement: Let Λ : Type (u+1) be a commutative ring, X,Y : Scheme.{u}, and f:X→Y. Let U_T be the exact sheafCompose functor forgetting ModuleCat Λ to AddCommGrpCat [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Direct image commutes with U by evaluation [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Applying rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange to this identity defines the canonical natural transformation R⁺f_*^Mod ⋙ D⁺U_Y → D⁺U_X ⋙ R⁺f_*^Ab [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. This fixed, unit-compatible transformation is an isomorphism for every f. No properness, torsion, or smallness of Λ in Type u is assumed.

proof.text: Coefficient restriction along Z→Λ is both a left and a right adjoint after the integer-module equivalence. Its sheaf functor preserves finite limits and colimits. Use the proved moduleSheafForgetIsLeftAdjoint helper for the left adjoint.

Transfer injectivity of the sheaf of modules to its underlying module presheaf using injective_module_sheaf_injective_presheaf. At p=q+1 apply injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift_max with hom universe u and coefficient/index universe u+1. CochainComplex.of_d identifies the differentials with differentialValue; ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff and ExactAt.isZero_homology give zero SiteCechComplex cohomology. The original etale comparison and remaining conclusion then follow unchanged. This replaces the invalid common-universe ringed-site acyclicity invocation.

Apply the Cech vanishing criterion with all objects and all covers. Every cover refines itself and every intersection is in this collection. Thus every positive right derived evaluation of I_ab vanishes.

By higherDirectImageSheafifiedPresheaf, higher direct images of I_ab are sheafifications of presheaves with these vanishing values. The presheaf is zero objectwise, hence zero; sheafification preserves zero objects. Transport through the higher-direct-image isomorphism and the proved plus/classical homology comparison to obtain rightAcyclic for abelian f_*.

Direct image commutes definitionally with forgetting. Apply isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_of_rightAcyclic to this coefficient square and the preceding acyclicity. This is exactly the canonical comparison in the statement.
